item.title: STM 306 - Yogev Freilichman - Secret Thirteen
item.description: Jerusalem’s hidden jewel Yogev Freilichman of Failed Units crafts abstract, eclectic mix that explores the sublime balance between poetic and raw soundspaces.

item.title: STM 307 - UNKNOWN - Secret Thirteen
item.description: Unknown of Buenos Aires- based collective KNIFE forges a mix that feels like a soundtrack of conflict and unrest through the more extreme shades of industrial techno.

item.title: Kamé - Bleeding Out Shadows Of The Past - Knife Records - Secret Thirteen
item.description: Extraordinary Argentinian underground music community KNIFE creates a new tape label —KNIFE Records— and choses Kamé for their first release.

item.title: STM 308 - No Master, No Servant - Secret Thirteen
item.description: With STM 308, Montreal collective No Master, No Servant reviews the game-changers in electronic music of the last four decades, from industrial and EBM to new beat and more.

item.title: STM 309 - Warrego Valles - Secret Thirteen
item.description: Slovenian duo Warrego Valles turns club music on its head with a fun and challenging mix that uncovers eerie techno gems, pop songs about crushes, and the quirkiest takes on deconstruction.

item.title: STM 310 - Das Ding - Secret Thirteen
item.description: Das Ding smashes today’s social, political and cultural dynamics with a frantic sound collage combining post-punk, no wave, industrial, electro, space-rock, noise-rock… and Woody Guthrie

item.title: STM 311 - Arigto - Secret Thirteen
item.description: With STM 311, German duo Arigto explores the interspace between gentleness and distortion centered around their latest EP Persona.

item.title: STM 312 - DYL (Achordat)
item.description: Eduard Costea (DYL) breaks the silence with a raw, 60-minute live recording of unreleased material. A timeless journey through 170 BPM, colossal reverbs, and hypnotic 4x4 rhythms, marking the launch of his label Achordat.

item.title: STM 313 - MITH-XX - Secret Thirteen
item.description: MITH-XX returns with a 3-hour eulogy for a collapsing world, bridging Power Electronics roots with the rawest edges of the contemporary noise underground.

item.title: STM 314 - TRSSX
item.description: TRSSX delivers an 86-minute all-vinyl mix across three turntables — a deep journey through industrial drone, polyrhythmic techno and dark ambient from the co-founder of Glasgow's EXIT club.
